answer: Prayers & Duties >> Taharah (Purity) Question ID: 42944 Country: KW Title: Peeing while standing Question: I work in an office where majority of persons are non-Muslims and while using the toilet they pee on the commode (toilet seat) and leave it dirty and filthy. Now if the toilets are not clean to sit can one pass urine while standing? Answer ID: 42944 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 66/56/L=1434) It is makrooh to urinate in the state of standing. However, if it is difficult to urinate sitting due to impurity then it is allowable to urinate standing. (Shami, Vol. 1, p. 557) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
